definition: Both knee angles (12-13-14, 16-17-18) > 150 deg AND hip height y(0)-floor > 0.8*H0 AND trunk angle(p20-p0, up) < 30 deg
description: Body is upright on extended legs.

definition: Hip height 0.45-0.75*H0 AND both thighs (p13-p12, p17-p16) within 30 deg of horizontal AND knee angles 60-120 deg AND trunk angle < 40 deg
description: Pelvis is supported at seat height with horizontal thighs.

definition: Hip height < 0.55*H0 AND knee angles < 90 deg AND horizontal distance hip-to-ankle < 0.4L (pelvis above feet)
description: Pelvis is low over the feet with deeply flexed knees.

definition: angle(p20-p0, up) > 60 deg AND y(20)-floor < 0.4*H0
description: Trunk is near horizontal close to the floor.

definition: Vertical velocity of p0 < -0.3 L/s for >= 0.3 s, total drop > 0.3L, peak downward speed < 1.2 L/s
description: Pelvis moves down in a controlled way.

definition: Vertical velocity of p0 > +0.3 L/s for >= 0.3 s, total rise > 0.3L, both feet stay within 0.05L of floor
description: Pelvis moves up while feet stay grounded.

definition: Peak downward speed of p0 and p20 > 1.5 L/s, drop > 0.5L, ending with trunk angle > 60 deg or y(0) < 0.4*H0
description: Body drops fast and uncontrolled toward the floor.

definition: Both feet (15,19) or ankles (14,18) > 0.05L above floor simultaneously for >= 3 frames
description: Neither foot touches the floor.

definition: Horizontal speed of p0 > 0.5 L/s sustained >= 1 s with net horizontal displacement > 1L
description: Whole body moves across the floor.

definition: Lateral sway of p20 relative to p0 along lat axis with amplitude > 0.2L AND step-interval coefficient of variation > 0.3 AND p0 path direction changes > 30 deg within 1 s
description: Body sways and steps irregularly as if losing balance.

definition: Forward trunk inclination: angle(p20-p0, up) 20-50 deg with (p20-p0)·f > 0
description: Trunk tilts moderately forward.

definition: angle(p20-p0, up) > 50 deg with (p20-p0)·f > 0 AND not body.lying
description: Trunk is folded far forward.

definition: angle(p20-p0, up) > 10 deg with (p20-p0)·f < 0
description: Trunk tilts backward.

definition: Horizontal-plane angle between shoulder line (p8-p4) and hip line (p16-p12) > 25 deg
description: Shoulders are rotated relative to hips.

definition: p20 moves 0.1-0.3L forward/down relative to p0 in < 0.3 s and returns to within 0.05L within 0.6 s
description: Upper trunk makes a brief sudden forward jolt.

definition: Sagittal angle of (p3-p2) relative to the trunk axis (p20-p0) increases by > 10 deg and returns by > 7 deg within 2 s (>= 1 down-up cycle; repeated cycles = nodding, one slow cycle = bow)
description: Head dips down and comes back up (nod or bow).

definition: Component of (p3-p2) along lat axis oscillates with amplitude > 0.03L and >= 2 reversals within 2 s
description: Head moves repeatedly side to side.

definition: Angle between (p3-p2) and (p20-p0) > 20 deg with forward component (p3-p2)·f > 0
description: Head is tilted down relative to the trunk.

definition: Highest hand: max(y7, y11) < y0
description: Even the higher hand is below hip level.
Higher hand is between hip and shoulder level.
Higher hand is between shoulder and top-of-head level.
Higher hand is raised above the head.
Both hands are raised above the head.

definition: For any hand: min dist(pH or pT, p3) < 0.35L AND (pH-p3)·f > 0 AND |(pH-p3)·lat| < 0.15L
description: A hand is at the front of the head.

definition: For any hand: dist(pH, p3) < 0.35L AND |(pH-p3)·lat| >= 0.15L
description: A hand is at the side of the head.

definition: For any hand: dist(pH, p3) < 0.4L AND yH > y3 + 0.05L
description: A hand is on top of the head.

definition: For any hand: dist(pH, p2) < 0.2L AND not hand.at_face
description: A hand touches the neck.

definition: For any hand: distance from pH to segment p0-p20 < 0.25L AND (pH-p1)·f in [0, 0.2L]
description: A hand touches the front of the trunk.

definition: For any hand: min dist(pH, p12 or p16) < 0.25L
description: A hand is at the side of the hip.

definition: For any hand: (pH-p1)·f < -0.15L AND |(pH-p1)·lat| < shoulder width ||p8-p4||
description: A hand is behind the trunk.

definition: For any hand: min dist(pH, any of 14,15,18,19) < 0.3L
description: A hand is near a foot.

definition: dist(p21 or p7, p10) < 0.15L OR dist(p23 or p11, p6) < 0.15L
description: One hand touches the other wrist or forearm.

definition: For any hand: (pH-p1)·f in [0.2L, 0.9L] AND y0 < yH < y3 AND no other contact-zone condition true
description: A hand is held in free space in front of the body.

definition: min(dist(p7,p11), dist(p21,p23)) < 0.12L
description: The two hands are in contact.

definition: sign((p6-p20)·lat) != sign((p4-p20)·lat) AND sign((p10-p20)·lat) != sign((p8-p20)·lat), each |·| > 0.05L
description: Each wrist is on the opposite side of the body midline.

definition: hands.touching AND relative velocity (v7 - v11) shows >= 3 reversals with displacement amplitude 0.03-0.15L within 2 s
description: The touching hands slide back and forth against each other.

definition: dist(p7,p11) cycles from > 0.25L to < 0.1L at least 2 times within 3 s with peak closing speed > 1 L/s
description: Hands repeatedly open apart and strike together.

definition: For any hand: (p_thumb - pH)·up > 0.05L AND (p_thumb - pH)·up > (p_tip - pH)·up
description: A thumb points upward above its hand.

definition: For any hand: (p_thumb - pH)·up < -0.05L AND (p_thumb - pH)·up < (p_tip - pH)·up
description: A thumb points downward below its hand.

definition: For any arm: elbow angle angle(S-E, W-E) > 150 deg
description: An elbow is nearly straight.

definition: For any arm: elbow angle < 80 deg
description: An elbow is sharply bent.

definition: For any arm: unit(E-S)·f > 0.6 AND angle(E-S, -up) > 45 deg
description: An upper arm is lifted toward the front.

definition: For any arm: unit(E-S)·lat_outward > 0.6 AND angle(E-S, -up) > 60 deg
description: An upper arm is lifted out to the side.

definition: For any hand: dist(pH, p1) increases by > 0.4L with mean speed 0.3-2 L/s
description: A hand moves outward away from the trunk at moderate speed.

definition: For any arm: hand speed along f peaks > 2 L/s AND elbow angle increases > 40 deg within 0.4 s
description: A hand shoots rapidly forward as the elbow straightens.

definition: For any hand: starts with yH > y20, then downward velocity peak > 2.5 L/s with drop > 0.4L within 0.4 s
description: A hand swings fast downward from above shoulder height.

definition: For any hand: upward velocity peak > 2 L/s starting from yH < y20, duration < 0.4 s, followed by deceleration
description: A hand flicks quickly upward.

definition: For any hand: horizontal speed peak > 2 L/s AND horizontal path length > 0.8L AND pH crosses the sagittal midplane through p0-p20
description: A hand sweeps fast in a horizontal arc across the body.

definition: For any hand: (pH-pE)·lat oscillates with amplitude > 0.1L, frequency 0.8-4 Hz, >= 2 full cycles
description: A hand swings repeatedly side to side.

definition: For any hand: yH oscillates with amplitude 0.1-0.5L, >= 2 full cycles within 3 s
description: A hand moves repeatedly up and down.

definition: For any hand: position of pH relative to pW or pE has dominant frequency > 2 Hz with amplitude < 0.1L for >= 1 s
description: A hand makes small rapid repetitive movements.

definition: For any arm: angle of (pH-pS) projected onto its best-fit plane sweeps > 270 deg continuously with |pH-pS| > 0.6 * arm length
description: An arm traces large circles around the shoulder.

definition: Exactly one foot (15 or 19) > 0.1L above floor while the other is within 0.05L of floor, for >= 5 frames
description: Body stands on one leg.

definition: Feet 15 and 19 alternately lift > 0.1L, >= 2 lifts per foot within 3 s, while horizontal displacement of p0 < 0.3L
description: Feet lift alternately while staying in place.

definition: For any leg: knee angle < 60 deg AND (pAnkle - pKnee)·f < -0.15L AND yAnkle > yKnee - 0.1L
description: A lower leg is folded up behind the thigh.

definition: For any leg: foot velocity along f peaks > 2 L/s AND knee angle increases > 30 deg AND foot rises > 0.3L above floor
description: A foot is driven quickly forward.

definition: For any leg: outward lateral foot velocity peaks > 1.5 L/s AND hip abduction angle(pAnkle-pHip, -up) in frontal plane > 30 deg
description: A foot is driven quickly out to the side.

definition: Distance d = ||p0_A - p0_B|| decreases at > 0.3 L/s for >= 1 s
description: The two persons get closer.

definition: d = ||p0_A - p0_B|| increases at > 0.3 L/s for >= 1 s
description: The two persons move apart.

definition: f_A · unit(p0_B - p0_A) > 0.7 AND f_B · unit(p0_A - p0_B) > 0.7
description: The two persons face each other.

definition: f_A · f_B > 0.7 AND one person's p0 lies behind the other along f (|unit(p0_B - p0_A)·f_A| > 0.7)
description: One person is behind the other, both facing the same way.

definition: min distance between any hand joint of A {7,11,21,23} and any of B < 0.15L
description: A hand of one person meets a hand of the other.

definition: Any hand of A within 0.2L of any of B's joints {2,3,4,8,20}
description: A hand reaches the other person's head, neck or shoulder.

definition: Any hand of A within 0.25L of segment p0_B-p1_B or of p12_B/p16_B, with (pH_A - p1_B)·f_B > 0 or lateral offset > 0.15L
description: A hand touches the other person's trunk or hip from front or side.

definition: Any hand of A: (pH_A - p1_B)·f_B < -0.1L AND |(pH_A - p1_B)·lat_B| < shoulder width of B
description: A hand touches the other person's back.

definition: Both hands of A satisfy inter.hand_to_other_back simultaneously AND d(p1_A, p1_B) < 1L
description: One person's arms wrap around the other's trunk.

definition: Any foot/ankle of A {14,15,18,19} within 0.25L of any of B's {13,14,15,17,18,19}
description: A foot of one person reaches the other's lower leg or foot.

definition: Within 0.5 s after any A-to-B contact relation, p0_B or p20_B acceleration away from A > 3 L/s^2 with displacement > 0.2L
description: The other person is pushed back after contact.
The two heads are very close together.

definition: For any arm of A: arm.extended AND angle(pT_A - pS_A, p3_B - pS_A) < 15 deg AND ||pT_A - p3_B|| > 1L
description: An extended arm of one person is aimed at the other's head or body.

definition: A second skeleton B is tracked with valid (non-zero) joints in >= 50% of frames AND B has a plausible body extent (y3_B - min(y15_B, y19_B) > 0.5*H0)
description: A second person is present in the scene.

definition: Speeds of p7 and p11 relative to p1 both exceed 0.3 L/s in overlapping windows covering >= 0.5 s
description: Both hands are moving at the same time (bimanual action).

definition: One hand moves relative to p1 (speed > 0.3 L/s for >= 0.5 s) while the other hand stays still (speed < 0.1 L/s) over the same window
description: Only one hand is moving while the other hand stays still.
The two hands are close to each other without touching, as if holding an object between them.

definition: dist(p7,p11) goes from < 0.15L to > 0.35L within 1 s
description: The hands start together and quickly pull apart.

definition: For any hand with yH > y0: speed of pH relative to p1 < 0.08 L/s for >= 1 s, after the hand moved > 0.3L to reach that position
description: A hand is raised to a position and held still there (holding a gesture).

definition: For any hand: the hand-plane normal (pTip - pH) x (pThumb - pH) rotates about the forearm axis (pH - pW) by > 60 deg with >= 2 reversals within 2 s
description: A wrist twists back and forth, as when turning a cap or a cube.

definition: For any hand: dist(p_thumb, p_tip) < 0.04L (joints 22-21 or 24-23) for >= 3 frames
description: The thumb tip touches the finger tip of the same hand.

definition: Angle between (p3-p2) and (p20-p0) > 15 deg with backward component (p3-p2)·f < 0
description: Head is tilted back, face turned upward.

definition: Total time with mean joint speed relative to p1 > 0.3 L/s is < 1.2 s
description: The movement is short and happens once.

definition: Total time with mean joint speed relative to p1 > 0.3 L/s is > 2.5 s
description: The movement goes on for a long time.

definition: Within overlapping 1 s windows, a hand of A and a hand of B each move toward the other person (distance to the other p1 decreases by > 0.3L)
description: Both persons reach a hand toward each other.

definition: body.standing occurs before body.lowering
description: First, body is upright on extended legs. Then, pelvis moves down in a controlled way.

definition: body.lowering occurs before body.sitting
description: First, pelvis moves down in a controlled way. Then, pelvis is supported at seat height with horizontal thighs.

definition: body.sitting occurs before body.rising
description: First, pelvis is supported at seat height with horizontal thighs. Then, pelvis moves up while feet stay grounded.

definition: body.rising occurs before body.standing
description: First, pelvis moves up while feet stay grounded. Then, body is upright on extended legs.

definition: hands.touching occurs before hands.pull_apart
description: First, the two hands are in contact. Then, the hands start together and quickly pull apart.

definition: hand.behind_torso occurs before hand.at_torso_front
description: First, a hand is behind the trunk. Then, a hand touches the front of the trunk.

definition: hand.at_torso_front occurs before hand.behind_torso
description: First, a hand touches the front of the trunk. Then, a hand is behind the trunk.

definition: hand.in_front_space occurs before hand.at_foot
description: First, a hand is held in free space in front of the body. Then, a hand is near a foot.

definition: hand.at_foot occurs before hand.in_front_space
description: First, a hand is near a foot. Then, a hand is held in free space in front of the body.

definition: hand.in_front_space occurs before hand.at_face
description: First, a hand is held in free space in front of the body. Then, a hand is at the front of the head.

definition: hand.at_face occurs before hand.in_front_space
description: First, a hand is at the front of the head. Then, a hand is held in free space in front of the body.

definition: hand.in_front_space occurs before hand.at_head_top
description: First, a hand is held in free space in front of the body. Then, a hand is on top of the head.

definition: hand.at_head_top occurs before hand.in_front_space
description: First, a hand is on top of the head. Then, a hand is held in free space in front of the body.

definition: body.standing occurs before body.falling
description: First, body is upright on extended legs. Then, body drops fast and uncontrolled toward the floor.

definition: inter.hand_to_other_trunk occurs before inter.other_displaced
description: First, a hand touches the other person's trunk or hip from front or side. Then, the other person is pushed back after contact.

definition: hand.in_front_space occurs before hand.at_head_side
description: First, a hand is held in free space in front of the body. Then, a hand is at the side of the head.

definition: hand.at_head_side occurs before hand.in_front_space
description: First, a hand is at the side of the head. Then, a hand is held in free space in front of the body.

definition: hand.head_level occurs before hand.above_head
description: First, higher hand is between shoulder and top-of-head level. Then, higher hand is raised above the head.

definition: hand.at_face occurs before hand.at_head_side
description: First, a hand is at the front of the head. Then, a hand is at the side of the head.

definition: body.lowering occurs before body.squatting
description: First, pelvis moves down in a controlled way. Then, pelvis is low over the feet with deeply flexed knees.

definition: hands.touching occurs before hand.at_face
description: First, the two hands are in contact. Then, a hand is at the front of the head.

definition: hand.below_hip occurs before hand.head_level
description: First, even the higher hand is below hip level. Then, higher hand is between shoulder and top-of-head level.

definition: hand.head_level occurs before hand.below_hip
description: First, higher hand is between shoulder and top-of-head level. Then, even the higher hand is below hip level.

definition: hand.torso_level occurs before hand.below_hip
description: First, higher hand is between hip and shoulder level. Then, even the higher hand is below hip level.

definition: hand.below_hip occurs before hand.torso_level
description: First, even the higher hand is below hip level. Then, higher hand is between hip and shoulder level.

definition: hand.at_head_top occurs before hand.above_head
description: First, a hand is on top of the head. Then, higher hand is raised above the head.

definition: inter.approaching occurs before inter.other_displaced
description: First, the two persons get closer. Then, the other person is pushed back after contact.

definition: hand.fast_thrust occurs before inter.hand_to_other_hand
description: First, a hand shoots rapidly forward as the elbow straightens. Then, a hand of one person meets a hand of the other.

definition: inter.hand_to_other_hand occurs before hand.at_face
description: First, a hand of one person meets a hand of the other. Then, a hand is at the front of the head.
